title: Contract-teacher demonstration over unpaid wages in Anjouan
location: Public-service office, Anjouan; town not reported
organizer: Contract teachers of Anjouan colleges and lycées; named organization not reported
participants_original: une cinquantaine de contractuels (about fifty contract teachers)
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporary report says approximately fifty (une cinquantaine), which does not establish a definite count of at least 50. No bounds are supplied.

title.summary: Comores Infos labels the action a demonstration and reports contract teachers gathered at the Anjouan public-service office on February 11.

start_date.summary: The article’s publication line and account identify February 11, 2021 as the gathering date.

location.summary: The report locates the gathering at the public-service office in Anjouan; no town is specified.

organizer.summary: The account attributes the gathering to contract teachers from Anjouan colleges and lycées; no union or organizer is named.

demands.summary: Teachers sought payment of long-unpaid wages and regularization; the event is framed as a labor/wage dispute.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The article uses an approximate phrase meaning around fifty; that is not a precise minimum confirming the 50-person rule.

notes: The wage arrears reportedly began years before the gathering; they do not date the protest. The state target is suggested by the public-service office and subject matter, but the precise employer/authority to whom the demand was addressed is not specified. The approximate attendance remains the main threshold blocker.
open_questions: Was simultaneous attendance at least 50, rather than approximately 50?
Was this an open public demonstration or a closed delegation/meeting at the office?
Which state authority employed the contract teachers and received the demand?
Identify any organizer, physical end, and any state response.
Locate an accessible original or independent contemporary account; the report mentions an activist’s Facebook live but does not identify its URL.
